summary: Profusa, Inc., a Nasdaq-listed medical device company, filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 5 to its February 11, 2025 Securities Purchase Agreement with Ascent Partners Fund LLC and an additional closing of a senior secured convertible promissory note. The note has a principal amount of $714,285.72 issued for $650,000, reflecting an original issue discount, bears 7% annual interest payable monthly in cash or shares, matures August 12, 2027, and converts at $1.07 per share. The amendment resets a warrant exercise price to $1.07.
